automanifest.description: Default name for the manifest file to look for automatically.

manifest.description: Name of the manifest file for both old and new source trees.

oldmanifest.description: Name of the manifest file for the old source tree.

newmanifest.description: Name of the manifest file for the new source tree.

patchlevel.description: Alternate file used in lieu of patchlevel.h.

description.description: Descriptive text for this patch. Items are strings.

infocmd.description: Command output added before each patch chunk. Uses %oP and %nP substitutions.

exclude.description: Shell patterns for files to exclude. Items are strings.

exclude_regex.description: Perl regex patterns for files/directories to exclude. Items are strings.

exclude_cvs.description: Exclude CVS related files and directories.

exclude_rcs.description: Exclude RCS related files and directories.

exclude_sccs.description: Exclude SCCS related files and directories.

ignore_cvs_keywords.description: Ignore differences in CVS keyword data.

ignore_rcs_keywords.description: Ignore differences in RCS keyword data.

extract.description: Additional extraction rules for archives in 'pattern=command' format. Items are strings.

tmpdir.description: Area where temporary files are placed.
